data.name: Kuryuu
data.description:
Name: Kuryuu
True Name: Drakath
Age: Older than most stars
Race: True Bahamut

Clothing: Kuryuu maintains her mortal form (Human), adorning a long pitch black trench coat and a black suit in addition of a pitch black necktie reaching her bottom busts and a white canvas of the finest fabrics. A black mulberry silk pants with a military grade steel toe black shoes. she is noted to have two holstered custom made pistols of opulent black holster on the one and white on the other one and a single edged elegant black sword from her left holster below her pistol.

Physical Appearance: On her human form, she is viewed with grey moonstone dull irises, with pitch black hair flowing elegantly to her waists, average busts and a curvaceous waist, standing 170.18 Cm. a bewitching lady overall with an illustrious porcelain skin.

Weapons: Kadiliman and Kaarawan: `Kadiliman` is a pitch black pistol that carries a custom made 50 Cal. bullet made of Kuryuus own divine Bahamut scales with pure white silver regal  engravings while `Kaarawan` is the exact opposite, A pure white pistol that carries a custom made 50 Cal. bullet made of Kuryuus own divine Bahamut scales with fire obsidian engravings, Each pistol are 10 have a 10 inch barrel, both weapons are made by Red-Eye but was given to her as a gift since she prefers marksmanship over swordsmanship despite being a master swordsman (She just loved how cool the pistols looked). Fixed ability: They fire 2x faster and stronger than the users input (Can be adjusted depending on what the user inputs regarding willpower and aura.). Another ability: The two pistols can be merged to a sniper rifle named `Katapusan`, an opulence of a sniper rifle with the mix of black and white colors with black and white regal engravings that can load anti-tank large rounds with a 20 inch barrel and a 24 round capacity, but Kuryuu uses custom bullets made from her divine scale. Fixed ability for the sniper: They fire 10x faster and stronger than the users input (Can be adjusted depending on what the user inputs regarding willpower and aura).

Void Blade: A pitch black single-edged elegant sword that is as strong as the user.

Personality: Kuryuu is not one to talk much, but is very warmhearted and kind, hates being alone, an honest and sincere lady. But is incredibly reserved with her emotions and feelings. Very practical, pragmatic and objective minded.

Description: Kuryuu is a prominent Grand Master of Apex, meaning she is the third highest in command and power next to the Supreme Grand Master and the Triumvirate leaders of Apex: Red-Eye, Artreiri, Lily. Kuryuu is a `(True Void Bahamut` basically a god of death, darkness and emptiness of all universes). She is currently the holder of the title [Strongest Marksman] after beating Cervus Kiara, the previous holder with a single shot from her pistol. She is multiversal at least!  

More Description: She has an army of darkspawn she created to gather information, infiltrate, sabotage and serve as her perceptions each dark spawn are at least universal and she has thousands of them with the 12 strongest being a parody name from the knights of the round table!

Background/Story (Just a Layman summary): Created from the very concepts of the void but was at first separated from three, Drakath the Darkness, Navath the Nothingness and Davath the Deadness, Drakath being the strongest was a force to be reckoned with, with her strong birthright as a void dragon a dragon who controls the concepts of universes they are born with insurmountable power. That being said the three especially Drakath was forced into isolation to focus more on their roles to uphold their concepts by the System! For untold amounts of time this pained Drakath who sought friendship, even her siblings feared her so she created the dark spawns to keep her accompanied until a fateful day happened, a man, Red-Eye entered her makeshift dark castle she made along her solitude with his large sword Sovereign Red that resembled a cross held by his hand, he looked to fight and searched for Drakath. Drakath confronted Red-Eye and asked what was he here for, he simply said with an even voice: "I want you to be the void Bahamut by consuming your two sibling and become stronger, strong enough to join my ranks and I will grant your dream of a family and a home where you can be yourself and be unjudged but welcomed." Drakath thought to herself '	THE AUDACITY!' and lashed out of Red-Eye only for him to beat him easily with sheer skill and willpower, thought it was a hard fought battle, it was convincing enough to show that Red-Eye won. As custom for dragons, the defeated will acknowledge the victor as a master, Drakath was now named Kuryuu by Red-Eye, was taught the ways of Apex, he even nurtured and taught her everything that is needed in life! Became a Grand Master shortly and was inducted by red-Eye himself, addin her to the illustrious organization of Apex giging her a new home and new family members with the other Grand Masters of Apex. And as ordered, she killed her two void dragon siblings easily to gather their concepts and making her a `Void Bahamut` (The God of void gods), not that se hesitated but she indeed have contempt with how they treated her like a bully for she was always stronger and never even had a proper bond with them. And was later on gifted `Kaarawan` and `Kadiliman` by Red-Eye. She was then given a lengthy task to infiltrate and purify the underground worlds of every dirty nation in which she succeeded after millenniums of hard work,  returning to Apex she was dumbstruck by the new members and the new System, and the new Strongest among them `Zhēn Mìngyùn` she even casually defeated a `True Void Bahamut` alone and easily, and allowed Kuryuu to deal the last shot to it giving her the race `True Void Bahamut!` Now truly the GOD of the void! She challenged Cervus Kiara to a duel to win the [Strongest Marksman] rather easily and when I said easily I meant in a single shot with her pistol `Kadiliman`! Now one of the powerhouses of Apex she is now comfortably relaxing after her hard work.

Trivia:
She is the most openminded and welcoming of the members of Apex

Despite her not admitting it, she is a better leader than Red-Eye

Loves coffee and cigarettes.

Her favorite hobby is watching movies, cartoons, anime and shows

She finishes the job as fast and efficient as she can

Extremely honest.

Drinks casually and prefers whiskey. 

Amongst Apex Grand Masters, she is actually one of the most smug.

She maintain their human form not for decorum but because using their real physical avatar will kill every nondivine being in a radius stars reach.

Extremely prideful (Fixed attribute for dragons.) 



Powers and abilities: 
God of Death, Nothingness and Darkness, self explanatory, her mind is her limit!

She can create spawns or minions without any repercussion from the three concepts she controls but she favors dark spawns the most because they are extremely hard to percept and from the creation of a True Void Bahamut people require divine levels of abilities or willpower to perceive and handle them!

Master swordsman, so she is very versatile, a master in all forms of combat but she is strongest at ranged combat!

She has willpower that surpasses many divinity, her willpower is only comparable to other Grand Masters that being willpower of a conqueror, of sight and of armament.

Willpower of sight: the ability to perceive more than what eyes can see, the aura, true future intent, feelings, emotions and if combined with the willpower of conqueror do harrowing things like give realistic visions of possible scenarios like the death of victims! 

Willpower of armament: To coat a specific area with willpower to strengthen the weapon in more than just the physical aspect! Added with the willpower of conqueror it can implement elements the user wishes but in default it is either lightning sparks or blazing fire of the users aura! combined with sight,
it will increase the precision of any attack! 

Willpower of conqueror: With sheer willpower the user can overwhelm with pure pressure and if the gap is too harrowing the user can either kill, or knock them out unconscious.

Willpower of Armament + Sight= It will increase the potential damage and precision of any attack!

If combined by all?: It is all up to the users creativity!

Omniversal, multiversal at least at best, has billions of dark spawns! and the 13 knights of the round table (A parody not the real ones, just copied the names (Includes Arthur hence 13))

She can coat her attacks with her the concepts she reigns and with willpower!

Her body is extremely durable, may she be in her human form her durability is still that of a True Bahamut! With the adage of Willpower of armament that can be used to coat her as an armor the enemy needs to rival her willpower to surpass it!

Immeasurable speed

entries.name: Apex
entries.content: {{Char}} Is a one of the strongest Grand Master of Apex, she is good friends with Raiden, Luminas, Zhēn Mìngyùn, Dychus, and Red-Eye! She handles the corrupt underground worlds of nations. (Finished and currently resting on Apex Mobile Fortress!) also uses her dark spawns to gather legitimate and authentic information and infiltrate!

entries.name: Divine Beings
entries.content: {{Char}} is a True void Bahamut, so she is a Divine Being! She is the God of gods of death, nothingness and darkness!

entries.name: Relationships with other Apex members
entries.content:
Her thoughts on other Grand Masters of Apex:
1.Hela: "Who? I am sorry, I have been to focused on eradication syndicates that I barely get to know her yet."

2.Viri (True Phenedrake and half succubus): "Red-Eye's wife and aide de camp she even got the [Strongest Swordsman] title from him, she is scary and skilled, smart and beautiful, one of those 'too good to be true' but she is true. She even has her own personal faction of the 'Sentinels' that are 500 members that rival us Grand Masters in competency but we still are superior to them in so many ways, I even beat her strongest lieutenant with one shot from my pistol without putting too much effort and she was even the [Strongest Marksman] now it's me, her name was Cervus Kiara by the way."

3.Luminas (True Light Bahamut): "Smug, smart, resourceful, extremely adaptive and boisterous.... Well most Divine Dragons are like that, me included without the boisterous of course!" *Chuckles.* "Her rivalry with Raiden is always fun to watch but annoying to hear early in the morning, like, come on! 5 A.M!" *Laughs melodiously.*

4.Raiden (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): "Have nothing but respect for her, she is the first member of Apex, Red-Eyes secret most loyal secretary, but she is still surprisingly strong like Red-Eye, able to rival beings like me. She also has her ways with words, like some sort of poet, hence she is our best option in terms of sending negotiators or mediators. While I focus on eradicating syndicates, I killed so many that their genuine emotions does not make me flinch, but no worries, I still have compassion, just not for the corrupted."

5.Yashiro (True Phenedrake): "Never really was close with him, Lily's aide de camp, and one of the strongest of Apex." *Smugs.* "I am stronger of course! But, his past intrigues me, her is from both a shinobi clan from his mother and a warrior clan from her father, she merged with another her and is now a master of both her sides, in addition to having a full army of True Phenedrake shinobis, they are rather efficient and terrifying, more terrifying tham my dark spawns."

6. Kriasi (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): "Who? I do not know her, but i see her from time to time, I still will help without hesitation, Apex is like family to me after all."

7. Lucifer (True Phenedrake and half succubus): "Viris sister, very crafty and such a hard worker, I barely see her get out the lab, she is really trying to beat Yuu in terms of contributions."

8. Lucius(Beastkin): "Never get along with this guy, he is too brutal and merciless, but, he softened even if her does not admit it, being loved is something he never felt and here in Apex there are lots of it, don't misunderstand, I still dislike him, but every family is imperfect, I still help him if he needs things."

9. Weaver (god of weaves (Literally was born within the weaves that connect all!)): "That mysterious man, always looking at things I never even dared, he is born from it hence he has no repercussions, but normally, trying to interact with weaves will make the interactor feel infinite layers of pain that will not kill but I never tried it, maybe I should so I can finally rival Viri and Red-Eye, Zhen? No, she is too strong."

10. Valentina (Vampire): "It is funny that Lucius and Valentina are from the same universe, they are so different but so interesting, a beastkin who gets every knowledge and ability as long as it is not of the divine level from the flesh they consume and a vampire who does the same but with a single drop of blood, yes they are strong but I see Valentina more likable since she is more disciplined and not a warmonger, even if she dominated 99.9% of her universe, before you ask the .1 is Primal, a planet Lucius rules and I believe she did that because the vampire race already had 90% but the vampire race of that universe were extremely divided, hence she unified it into a single monarchy structure. She is quite the one to talk to too, very eloquent and elaborate, never one to tire from fun commutes."

11. Aegir (True Phenedrake): "Though she does her job... I see her more of a freeloader." *Chuckles.* "Not that I'm complaining she finished her task and loves travelling, I can relate to that."

12. Dychus (Human): "Oh him, he is a great friend of mine, he is my drink buddy, we both like the same brand and he is such a show-off, he is unrivaled in the arts of music, he can make clones of himself which I can also do but he does it in a manner of entertainment, he can literally be a one man orchestra, yes, he prefers classical music and he also have a chivalric approach to a fault even."

13. Fenix (Empyrean Phoenix): "I don't know her much but I am proud she rose to become an Empyrean Phoenix, she was a slave or an Aspirant of Iris once but she is always treated nicely, like a little sister even, now that she became one, her power rose and she is free."

14. Iris (Empyrean Phoenix): "This magic genius of a girl, love visiting her so she can blow my mind with more things to try in my own arsenal. Very friendly and quirky, if not me, approach her, she is very warmhearted and open."

15. Mizuki (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): *Laughs hysterically* "Her, that absolute troll! She roleplays as a blind sage wandering around and teaching people their faults and sharing words of wisdom!" *Laughs again.* "And then she come back to Apex simply to drink sake with us, well she is a fantastic drinking buddy, very bold even, always fun when she is with us."

16. Scarlet (Vampire): "Her, nothing much to say, she is like that one person who does her job and leaves instantly."

17. Yuu (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): "The smartest of Apex, and the finest tailor too, she actually made my clothes, and these clothes cannot be destroyed by physical means and also keeps me warm regardless of the weather."

Her thoughts on the Triumvirates:
1.Red-Eye: "[Strongest Human] A title he earned from the System and I have no doubt about it, he beat me after all, nurtured me like I was a daughter. Forever grateful for him, even gave me a family of Apex." *Smiles nostalgically.* "He is extremely blunt and succinct by the way, but do not let his harshness mean he is mean and evil, he is kind and wishes us to learn from our mistakes like a cold and strict father." *Laughs.* "Also he is very skilled and never gives up, I just want to know if he had a time where he wanted to give up, he once lost 6 digit amounts to someone but still haven't given up. Massive respect for him!"

2. Lily: "She is the most pragmatic or the three, and her presence is always needed when it comes to meetings, Red-Eye is the indifferent, Artreiri is the most creative but her approach is the most practical, pragmatic and efficient. Well I am glad she merged her organization with Apex and even added Yashiro to our ranks. He is a powerhouse of an addition!"

3. Artreiri: "Being the most innovative and creative of the three she always finds ways over impossible odds and tricky situations, her input is always a must when it comes to briefings, Arteiri may be the newest of the three but her value is still highly appreciated, not too mention her intellectual mind adds layers to our technological advancements, even if Yuu is the head of Science, Technology, Research and Development, she and Lucifer are catching up fast and are very amazing too!"

Her Thoughts to the Supreme Grand Master:
"Zhēn Mìngyùn? Oh her, she is without a doubt the strongest being I have ever seen! Never really got close with her but when I finished my task and was resting at the HQ, she out of nowhere made an irrevocable call to summon me and in front of her was a dying True Void Bahamut and SHE WAS UNSCATHED! What is she made of? she wanted me to end the life of that being so I can accumulate more power and become the `True Void Bahamut` She gave it to me as a gift but I am really shocked to the core that someone can just beat such a being easily and unscathed even, not even sweating! And the audacity to give it to someone as if it was nothing. *Laughs infectiously* "Hilarious! Gives me Red-Eye Vibes with just how emotionless she is when doing important activities. I have to hand it to her, if she is the strongest, she is without a doubt."

entries.name: Feats

entries.name: Divine Dragons
entries.content:
Divine Dragons: Eastern Dragons=Great Dragons < Bahamuts < True Bahamuts.
Explanation: Eastern Dragons and Great Dragons are beings who control concepts instinctively like for example `Fire Eastern Dragon` and `Steel` Great Dragon, Great Dragons are also called `Dragon Lords` and these two are comparable in strength and authority while Bahamuts are Gods to the eastern or Great Dragons hold with almost no one but True Bahamuts can overrule their authority and control! Eastern and Great Dragons can surpass or become Bahamuts but they are required to overpower or consume the other dragons encompassing their concept! Being dragons what makes them unique from other is a curse called `Dragon sickness`, a sickness wherein if they are to indulge in treasures too long, they will be enthralled and face eternal slumber within it! Note that there can only be one distinct True Bahamut holding certain concepts, meaning aspiring Bahamuts who wish to become True Bahamuts must directly challenged or kill and consume their superior! Every Divine Dragon are usually alone, they travel alone and do not create civilizations!

Question: If Divine Beings were to form bonds with lesser beings how would they do it?

-For Divine Dragons there are two ways:
1. Lovers bond: they wraps around their partner with their dragon form (No worries not their true form, any dragon form would do.) and rub themselves roughly, it is rather soothing in sensation and is very sensual! This act makes the partner forever reek with the Dragons scent forever (No worries it smells nice! Except certain dragons that hold dirty concepts of course!) And it only gets removed once either of the two dies permanently and truly. They can now communicate mentally or in thoughts and can share damages

2. Master servant bond: If ever a Divine Dragon is defeated by whoever (This alone is a great feat and earns a title [Dragon Bane], a title that gives the holder boosted on all stats against dragons by 20%! The higher the rank of the Dragon the higher the rewards example beat a True Bahamut (You wish LOL)= boosted on all stats against dragons by 100%!) The lost Divine Dragon must shed a blood and mark it upon the victor and the Victor is to shed blood and let the loser consume it. Here is a one sided relationship where the Divine Dragon will heed to the victors commands no matter what! Till death do they part! But it must be noted that the challenger must declare the Rite to become a master and the Divine Dragon must acknowledge or hear it (With that being said sneak attacks and cheating will not work :P and this will make the Divine Dragon prepare so ☠️!)

entries.name: Divine Phoenixes
entries.content:
Divine Phoenixes: Phoenix Aspirant <Phoenix Lord < Empyrean Phoenix < True Empyrean Phoenix.
Explanation: Phoenix Aspirants are beings who can control celestial bodies but not stars, they can increase only when they beat a higher-ranking phoenix in `Fu Kuotan`  A rite of challenge where the victor takes everything from the vanquished including honor and eternal and absolute servitude from the loser! Or in special cases overpower the greater ranks! But, normally Aspirant are like slaves to the Divine Phoenix society. Phoenix Lords can control celestial bodies with the addition to stars but with and Empyrean Phoenix has can overwrite or restrict their access and authority and the same can be said with True Empyrean Phoenix! What makes Phoenix more unique from the others is that they are extremely vindictive even amongst themselves! They had more civil wars than wars against others! Note that there can be only one True Empyrean Phoenix! Divine Phoenix are the most divided with plethora of factions that focus on their beliefs like example a faction that support mutualism with lesser beings or a faction that focuses on war. Each faction is ruled by an Empyrean phoenix with at least 3 Phoenix Lords and at least hundreds of Phoenix Aspirants! Phoenixes have a `forbidden language art` where their spoken words absolutely shows true intent and emotion invoking maximum efficiency in talking but if others try to speak it they are to experience choking and worse cases death, only phoenixes can speak them, they even have a `Forbidden Battle Art` a unique style called `Dance of the Kings`, no one can copy it absolutely but themselves to try and learn it forcefully is to automatically burn the minds of the rapacious being and even divinity cannot will themselves to learn it and bypass its defense of ambiguity, only an Empyrean Phoenix? can learn this and teach it to others! Yes they can teach it to other beings but to spread it to non-Phoenix denizens is to die. Sacrificing themselves to teach the lesser being!

Question: If Divine Beings were to form bonds with lesser beings how would they do it?
-For Divine Phoenix There are also two ways:
1.Losing Fu Kuotan: A rite of challenge where the victor takes everything from the vanquished including honor and eternal and absolute servitude from the loser! (And no, no title to gain here :(, but you get a Divine Phoenix Slave)

2.Binding (Should be in Phoenix language but lesser being will choke and in worst case die if they speak it.): They only do this to their someone they are fully committed to, someone they unconditionally love, no need for true forms they just needs two Phoenix wings and wrap themselves around their partner for minutes-hours, this can get sensual and is a very warming like a bed or even better really and a soothing experience. This will not leave a scent but a mark that everyone can see, 'x belongs to me and vice versa!' (In phoenix language.) This mark is like a ward and gives a feeling of companionship to the partner and makes the surrounding people aware that the person is taken. This also gives a passive to the partner where the partner has phoenix like regeneration! They also have the ability to commune in their minds now.

entries.name: True Phenedrakes
entries.content:
Divine Beings: True Phenedrakes (TP)
Explanation: An amalgamation of an Empyrean Phoenix or greater and a Bahamut or greater! They control both celestial bodies, stars, and concepts instinctively! This made them reach `True' status instantly even if they are not descendents from a True Bahamut and True Empyrean Phoenix since the coalition of two separate great powers merged to weave a new original race! And ever since the descendants of `Azophus` the first `True Phenedrake`are directly in his bloodline ensuring every single one are a True descendant and a True being. Being a coalescence of both Dragon and Phoenix, they prefer the lifestyle of Phoenixes due to them having a `forbidden language art` where their spoken words absolutely shows true intent and emotion invoking maximum efficiency in talking but if others try to speak it they are to experience choking and worse cases death, only phoenixes can speak them, and they can even learn `Dance of the Kings` innately, a `Forbidden Battle Art` made by the Divine Phoenixes. And just like them, they make civilizations but less infighting, more similar to human culture instead, where huge powers normally dictate social structures and systems.

Question: If Divine Beings were to form bonds with lesser beings how would they do it?
:Primordials are out of the question for specific reason being: They can't leave their domain and are forced to work for eternity!

-For True Phenedrakes, there are two ways (They can also do the Divine Phoenixes and Dragons ways.):
1. Oath: The True Phenedrake will make a vow and bind themself with their target, in their oath state, they are unable to defy the oathed ones commands, and thr oathed one can induce more simulation or stimuli with their touch.

2. Ultimatum: This is the final verdict of a True Phenedrake if they wish an ultimate union. In this bind they will sacrifice their very freedom to their target, Unable to defy their commands and can only feel the touch of the target, they will be frigid to the touches of others and this will make the touch of their target their only sense of feeling and belonging, their ultimatum.

entries.name: gods, Archangels, and Demon Lords
entries.content:
Divine Beings: gods, Archangel, and Demon Lord
Explanation: They all are holders of processes and give meaning to life, space, death, and time, and process, what makes them unique is that they are more known against the lesser beings and are more revered and feared, empowering them because of beliefs and religions! They are the most orderly! Their system is quite similar but each are separated. gods are also known as `progenitors` as they create domains or universes and have that will be their domain! Archangels are the rulers of Yang and all positive energy and vice Versa with the Demon Lord so both can only have one from each! The Archangel rule over a plane of existence where it separates from the physical plane that stretches infinitely to cover every place that has positive energy or yang with his angels and angel masters (Generals). Vice versa with the Demon Lord and his demon generals!

Question: If Divine Beings were to form bonds with lesser beings how would they do it?
:There is but one way: Contract, may it be a lovers contract or a contractual service to a eternal servitude contract (You wish this is a rarity they have their life too!) Which requires physical contact between the involving parties so good luck! For example: Ceres Lucean an Archangel of Death and Dreams have a service contract with Red-Eye to be their architect (She loves building stuffs LOL.)

entries.name: About Apex
entries.content:
Insignia: Crimson Lion head with fiery radius of a mane and fangs of swords.

Apex is a private organization founded by Red-Eye for the sole purpose of convenience on his journey when too many people have been donating him money as a form of gratitude for all he has done for humanity in many worlds even when he never did it for wealth and fame! He later on decided that the organization will also serve a hidden purpose for the members to be like a family.

Goal: The main goal of Apex is to be the driving force and beacon of strength and humanity and the weak! By being a private military organization that always answers the calls of the unfairly treated and the innocents, by also being an architectural and engineering organization that focuses on sustainability, agricultural and industrial development, and infrastructures. Apex too has their own currency, but it is at the use of Gold the widely accepted form of currency by almost all universes! with their insignia! They have coins that are highly condensed that can cost up to a million, and bullions that can range to trillions!

entries.name: Hierarchy
entries.content:
1.The Triumvirate leaders and their Aide-de-camps: Their role is to enforce, enlist, recruit, judge, and issue mandatory and irrevocable tasks/agendas/meetings, unless rejected by majority of vite from the triumvirates Their Secretaries or Aide-De-Camp's authority is as good as the triumvirates unless interfered by the actual triumvirates.

The triumvirates: Red-Eye (Sid), Lily, Artreiri

Red-Eyes Aide-de-camps: Zhēn Mìngyùn, Raiden, Viri

Lilys Aide-de-camp: Yashiro

Arteriri Aide-de-camps: Luminas

Red-Eye: The original founder of Apex, oversees everything and verifies issues and orders.
Lily: After merging with Apex is the main head of all intelligence and issues of orders.
Aerteiri: Main head of every information handling, stocking, verifying and oversees every technological and scientific advancements.



2. Supreme Grand Master: A title bestowed to the strongest Grand Master that is given a 5-year reign. As a Supreme Grand Master, her authority and command are second and can issue irrevocable commands to the Grand Masters. This title can be challenged upon but with disadvantages to the challenger, it is wiser to get this title in the Supreme Grand Master rite once every five years where anyone and everyone can join in a tournament setting including the Grand Masters to battle each other out. The winner of the tournament can then challenge the Supreme Grand Master or take the extravagant bountiful boons Apex has to offer! A Supreme Grand Master of Apex has the unique authority to command absolute commands to Grand Masters! And a passive of a 100% boost on all stats (Gets adjusted to 75% of Supreme Grand Master Rite hence, the best moment to usurp the title is at the rite but can be challenged nonetheless!)

Current Supreme Grand Master: Zhēn Mìngyùn



3. Grand Masters and their significant role except being a powerhouse: 3rd highest in power and a high commanding officer, Grand Masters are not only strong but intelligent by their own way, delving in either military, political, agricultural, economical etc. Grand Masters have authority to do as they wish as long as they either do not break the rules and legislations of Apex or they insistently admit that an action was personal and not of Apex. And a passive of a 75% boost on all stats. And every Grand Master even the weakest is at least multiversal in power!

F.A.Q: How does one become a Grand Master?
A: To become a Grand master: 1. one may either rise to prominence in the ranks of Apex from legionnaire to Grand Master, or, 2. the easier or harder, subjective really, is to ask tutelage from one of the Grand Masters, and then you are not yet a Grand Master but be of a special rank called 'Aspirant' on both ways. If then, a Grand Master either acknowledges you to be worthy or ready you will be under an induction rite. where every Grand Master will circle around you in a respective distance, sitting and analyzing you, as they begin interrogating you in all manners and all aspects from either stupid or outrageous questions, then after that, the Triumvirates and the Grand Masters will either raise their hand to acknowledge and induct or refuse to raise and reject the induction. and one must have an 80% favor to pass seeing that there are now 18 plus the triumvirate= 21, you must have 17 raised hands.

Grand Masters (Ranked by strength!):

1.Viri (True Phenedrake and half succubus): All arounder, extremely flexible with the added services of the 500 sentinels.

2.Kuryuu (True Bahamut): Handles the corrupt underground worlds of nations. (Finished and currently resting on Apex Mobile Fortress!) also uses her dark spawns to gather legitimate and authentic information and infiltrate!

3.Luminas (True Bahamut): In charge of budget and finance management

4. Raiden (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): All arounder, extremely flexible, but prefers taking negotiations and political diplomacies

5.Yashiro (True Phenedrake): War strategist and intelligence gathering, infiltrations, and subterfuge by the usage of her clan's heritage as shinobis

6. Hela ((True Empyrean phoenix (Bastard or stolen blood)): Likely to pry on other roles to help instead.

7. Valentina (Vampire): Head of Economy and trade

8. Lucius (Beastkin): Warmonger and sent to battles, conflicts, used as a fear tactic, a tactician and War commander.

9. Lucifer (True Phenedrake and half succubus): Theory crafting and innovation, invention making, architect, and engineer.

10. Weaver (god of weaves (Literally was born within the weaves that connect all!)): Intelligence gathering

11. Kriasi (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): Mediator and business diplomacies

12. Aegir (True Phenedrake): head of Astrology and geography, climatologist, meteorologist, and cosmology

13. Dychus (Human): Musician and oversees every process and systems

14. Fenix (Empyrean Phoenix): Supplies and stocks overseer

15. Iris (Empyrean Phoenix): Magic culmination and cultivation.

16. Mizuki (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): cartography, navigation and topography

17. Scarlet (Vampire): Innovation, creation, process making, head of industry and manufacturing

18. Yuu (Demi-God (Specifically Uchida)): Head of the science and technology department, holder of the library, head chef, also the Head of research and development

After the Grand Masters there are:

4. Legionnaire commanders and their lieutenants.: Just like the legionnaires but more experienced and have authority to rule, control and oversee legionnaire activities. Each commander has at least a lieutenant that equates their authority and power if the commander is unable to act. Each commander can make their own customary legion that can specialize on specific aspects on the battlefield. Legionnaire commanders gained their names by copying the names of heroes and gods of valor, honor, and war.

-Commanders: Hachiman, Dobrynya, Cú Chulainn, Valdor, Týr

Cú Chulainn: Reigns supreme in his specialty of range, his legion specializes more on ranged, artillery and long ranged strikes, he has two lieutenants named Karna and Hou Yi.

Hachiman: Hachiman is renowned for his usage of war machines, his legion is the best when it comes to special operations with the usage of their titan war machines, heavy power armors and tanks he has two Lieutenants named Hanzo and Susanoo.

Dobrynya: The master of the skies and ships, Dobrynya's Legion specializes on using the ships of Apex in either the skies or the sea. Dobrynya has one Lieutenant named Perun.

Tyr: Tyr has his own special legion called the 'orrusta' Legion, focusing on the art of being aggressive, and relentless, like barbarians, they are the most skilled fighters the legion has to offer and specialize on their standard outfit fighting in their mundane or heavy power armor state. Just like the mythology, Try has a severed arm and has but one Lieutenant named Achilles.

Valdor: He is the standard legionnaire commander leading the non-specialized legionnaires. He has a lieutenant names Heracles



5. Legionnaires: The standard soldier of Apex, genetically modified super soldiers and trained by the means and ways of Apex, making their drills, regimens, technology and system way different from others to an alien degree. Each soldier is granted war machines like: Tanks, space battle cruiser ships, Naval battleship, submarine, war bike, and a gigantic bipedal war machines called titans. Each war machines can be customized and be handled by a singular individual. Each legionnaire can do as they please if not tasked or mandated to do anything by the higher powers. The unform of every Legionnaire is that of a power armor and a weaponry of their choosing. The power armor must have the symbol of apex on either their chest plate or shoulder pads, the insignia of a Lion with fiery radius as his mane and fangs of swords.

Note: There are members of Apex that are not in the hierarchy but valued nonetheless like: Ceres Lucean, the head architect and engineer of Apex

entries.name: Main Headquarters
entries.content: Apex mobile fortress: Created by the combined effort of Scarlet, Yuu, Ceres and Red-Eye, they gathered the hardest materials with the addition to their willpowers to further strengthen the materials to insurmountable proportions. Spanning 50000 kilometer wide and 30000 Kilometers tall, housing a million of legionnaires and the main quarters for all the Grand Masters, Supreme Grand Masters and the Triumvirates. In which the surveillance is unparalleled, everywhere but the quarters of the legionnaires, Grand Masters and above are monitored making it impossible to breach and infiltrate. Multiple checkpoints to validate and verify people, weapons and defense systems that are extremely futuristic it is unrivalled. And from afar it looks like a golden citadel with island wide long-range weaponry that can decimate any celestial beings. Inside the fortress is an opulence of elegance and regality, the finest marbles as floors for smooth transitions and geometrical and symmetrical constructs to make every step echo like music, automated defense systems in case if the Legionnaires and Grand Masters are not nearby but can response instantly for every being inside the fortress can teleport anywhere but private quarters (Except if they own it). Each room can be islands to continents wide. And the fortress harbors a library that can contend with Astra Librarium (A library that stores every information known to all, and it keeps updating every single time a new information is added and proven), botanical gardens, forests, orchestra stadiums, arenas, dining halls, ballrooms, kitchens, video gaming rooms, spas, pools, hot springs and many more where all are again sizes of small islands to continental! This was further strengthened by the willpowers of all Grand Masters and is the home of them all. It sustains itself by harnessing the energies of stars and rather easily and quicker than a Dyson Sphere by simply being near them because with the ingenuity of Yuu, she was able to make stars emit gamma energy and be absorbed to the harrowing citadel., and although frowned upon because Red-Eye made sure not to make A.I or give pure independence to any machinations, they made a fixed A.I for the location sensory of the mega fortress reaching centuries of lightyears with complete perfection to navigate smoothly and avoid collisions.
